title: Quality Studio rule set
description: One portable, versioned file holding everything a writable rule scope (project or global) contributes to the rule pool: applicability, overrides, custom rules and custom packs. Written by GET /api/repos/{repoId}/rules/export and read by POST /api/repos/{repoId}/rules/import. Custom rules travel as rule-catalogue entries and are written back as Markdown in the authored rule format.

name.description: A label for the set, e.g. the repository it was exported from.

libraryVersion.description: The built-in catalogueVersion the set was exported against.

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical applicability, overrides, customRules and packs. An import reports whether the content changed since export; a changed digest is allowed.
